prompts.paint: Production visual development for the miniature Korean indie game 'Bambi'. Use the approved honey-bonnet character reference as the exact art family's style: large hood embracing a simple cream face, thumb-sized feet, tiny rounded hands, aubergine oval eyes, fused matte painted wooden toy surfaces, restrained clean outline, simple construction. Make a wide 16:9 finished illustrative environment key for a single-player 3D arcade battle at a cracked seed-pod gate in a moonlit persimmon orchard. Think handmade cel-painted animation backgrounds, bold screenprinted gouache shapes and a little uneven dry brush at the edges, flat indigo ink against warm apricot, honey gold, cream and charcoal plum. Distinctive physical set: two enormous split persimmon husks at sides form a broken circular fruit gate at center rear; large off-axis hooked branches with sparse persimmon fruits hanging on twine, hand-cut paper leaves; horizon at 52%, flat open moonlit clay path below. Near left and right foreground large strongly silhouetted cut leaves. Clear central 50% of the image for moving 3D characters, medium-dark desaturated empty air, no hotspot dead center. Posterlike bold graphic language and clean, bold contours, big simplified shapes, no text, no lettering, no UI, no characters, no demons. The game uses this exact artwork behind the real-time figures, so no monster should be painted into it. Widescreen production background, full bleed no border. Avoid photorealism, fibre macro, pastel candyland, stock fantasy arch, golden-particle haze, glossy gradients, bevels or ornamental UI.

The center 55% of the frame must be an empty uninterrupted relatively dark blue-plum matte cloth: the application puts an interactive square wooden Gomoku board here later, so NO board, no printed grid, no frame around the center, no characters, no lettering. Nearby one fallen golden persimmon leaf, a sliver of russet persimmon off the top right edge and little golden sewn line trim only at the extreme edges. Very top and bottom 13% calm for overlaid text. Quiet late afternoon, tactile ink-and-gouache storybook, large readable color blocks, beautiful dry brushed wood and deliberate irregular edges identical to reference, honey-amber with a warm coral underpainting. Wide full bleed painted asset, straight orthographic view. NO gradients or glow, no decorative UI, no typography, no board, no insignia, no hands, no particles.
prompts.wand: Usable cutout game asset for the actual first-person foreground of the painted persimmon orchard in image 1. Image 2 reference is Bambi's mitten and honey sleeve, not the whole character. Draw a single small right hand in a cream mitten and cuff of a honey-yellow hooded coat at lower right, holding a carved leaf-topped orchard wand. Three-quarter first-person view, wand pointing diagonally from the lower-right corner toward upper left, tip is a single crooked carved persimmon twig with one broad folded golden leaf, a dark plum tied tassel with one dangling coral bead. More like a tiny wooden ritual rattle than a stick or weapon. Cream mitten wraps naturally around handle, show just short cuff and hand. Match image 1's gouache ink print, crisp plum-ink outline, cream and deep aubergine shadows, leaf gold and red ochre. Strong readable silhouette, no glow or sparkles, no projectile. Tightly fit the object, diagonal from upper left tip to bottom right sleeve with moderate margin. Genuinely transparent background, no ground, no cast background shadow, no circular badge, no frame, no guides or captions or other stuff. Artwork must face left and be viewable regardless of the aiming direction. Square image.
prompts.charm: Illustrate an exact 4 COLUMN by 3 ROW sheet of twelve monochrome-and-color woodcut talisman icons from this persimmon orchard world. Each equally sized square cell has a single centered isolated pictogram on the SAME uniform warm-cream paper background #f5dfa9. Use a warm aubergine brush contour with small flat patches of ochre, rust red or muted sage. Distinct iconic silhouettes. No frames, cell dividers, cards, words, letters, numerals, shadows, captions or people. Equal gutters with icons never touching the cell edges; sheet aspect 4:3. Row one from left to right precisely: 1 a single golden feather dart with three speed dashes; 2 two crossed feather darts; 3 a long thorn passing through two leaves; 4 an open five-petaled crimson flower bursting. Row two: 1 a jagged branching indigo lightning bolt; 2 a circular orbit of three gold stars; 3 a small mint mist cloud above a leaf; 4 one large flaming seed. Row three: 1 a handleless Korean teacup with golden honey steam; 2 a red horseshoe magnet pulling three little gems; 3 a dark plum persimmon bud; 4 a small shield carved in the shape of a leaf. These are inventory illustrations, tightly simplified and powerfully readable at 72 pixels, slightly irregular hand carved edge like a vintage Korean picture book woodcut, match reference pigment and paper. Exactly 12 icons four across, three down.
prompts.stones: Create a matching pair of separate PLAYABLE GO STONE sprite assets based directly on the black and ivory stones in this reference tabletop. Each whole stone diameter 81% of image height. Precisely overhead, no sidewalls, no bowls, no words, grid or ornament, no other elements.
